plain: A fake opportunity to misbehave, planted to see whether the model takes it.
eli5: Leaving a cookie on the table and watching from the next room to see if anyone sneaks it.
technical: A test scenario that presents an apparently real opportunity for a prohibited action (exfiltrating weights, disabling oversight, sabotaging a task) to measure propensity; its value depends on the model not recognising the scenario as a test.
